message.stagelite.no_permission: Only staff can change the lights.
commands.stagelite.bad_color: Invalid color. Use a name (red, blue...) or a 6-digit hex like ff8800.
commands.stagelite.bad_value: Invalid value. Use TAB completion to see the options.
commands.stagelite.scene_nothing: No loaded lights have a group (1-99). Assign groups first.
commands.stagelite.show_created: Show '%s' created. Add scenes with /stagelite show add.
commands.stagelite.show_step_added: Scene '%s' (%s s) added to show '%s'. Steps: %s.
commands.stagelite.show_cannot_play: Show '%s' does not exist or is empty.
tip.stagelite.preset: Quick color. Click to use it.
tip.stagelite.spread: Beam width. Low = thin ray, high = wide cone.
tip.stagelite.length: How far the beam reaches (in blocks).
tip.stagelite.range: How far the head moves (in degrees).
tip.stagelite.effect: How the light behaves: static, pulse, strobe or rainbow.
tip.stagelite.movement: How the head moves: still, sweep, nod, circle or figure eight.
tip.stagelite.power: Turn this light on or off.
tip.stagelite.group: Group (0-99). Lights in the same group are controlled together with /stagelite. Shift = steps of 5.
gui.stagelite.url_hint: Image link, file path, or drag an image
gui.stagelite.console.name: Scene name
gui.stagelite.console.empty: No grouped lights. Give them a group (1-99) in their panel.
tip.stagelite.holo_turn: Hologram rotation in Fixed mode (0 to 360 degrees).
tip.stagelite.extra_laser: Number of beams in the fan.
tip.stagelite.extra_smoke: How far the smoke reaches. Brightness is the amount. Strobe effect = in bursts.
tip.stagelite.extra_fire: Flame height. Strobe effect = bursts. Visual only: it does not burn anything.
tip.stagelite.extra_firework: Rocket height. Speed is the firing rate. Rainbow = random colors.
tip.stagelite.extra_disco: Number of light rays leaving the ball.
tip.stagelite.billboard: Faces player: the image always looks at you. Fixed: stays in one direction (Turn fader).
tip.stagelite.url: DIRECT link to an image (PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP), or a file path + Enter, or drag an image here. Videos and web pages do not work.
tip.stagelite.blackout: Turns every light off at once.
tip.stagelite.save_scene: Saves how every group looks right now as a scene.
tip.stagelite.tilt: Fixed tilt of the light: positive = up, negative = down.
tip.stagelite.yaw: Turns the light sideways (east-west, depending on how it is placed). Combines with Tilt.
tip.stagelite.pick_file: Pick an image from your computer (PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP). It is uploaded to the server so everyone sees it. You can also drag it onto this window.
gui.stagelite.img_dialog: Pick the image in the window that opened...
gui.stagelite.img_nodialog: Could not open the file picker. Drag the image onto this window or type its path and press Enter.
gui.stagelite.img_bad: Invalid file: use PNG, JPG, GIF or BMP.
tip.stagelite.movespeed: Speed of the movement and spin (separate from effect speed).
message.stagelite.molinete_no_space: Not enough free space for the molinete (needs a clear 13x13 area, 5 blocks high).
block.stagelite.speaker: Speaker
tip.stagelite.extra_speaker: How far the speaker can be heard (8 to 80 blocks). Volume comes from intensity.
tip.stagelite.extra_mic: How many blocks from the microphone voices are picked up.
tip.stagelite.track: Disc that loops. Shift = back to None.
tip.stagelite.volume: Volume. 0 = mute (video volume also fades with distance).
tip.stagelite.screen_range: How many blocks away the video is heard and loaded.
tip.stagelite.extra_screen: Image size (longest side). Screen: 2-20 blocks, frame: 1-10, projector: 3-30.
tip.stagelite.loop: Repeat the video when it ends.
tip.stagelite.restart: Reload the video from the start for everyone.
item.stagelite.video_remote.help: Right-click a screen = link. Right-click elsewhere = open panel. Sneak = unlink.
message.stagelite.remote_linked: Remote linked to the screen. Right-click to open the panel.
message.stagelite.remote_hint: Aim at a screen and right-click to link the remote.
message.stagelite.remote_missing: The linked screen no longer exists or is not loaded. Link another one.
message.stagelite.remote_far: You are too far from the linked screen.
tip.stagelite.throw: How many blocks it projects (stops at the first wall, floor or ceiling).
tip.stagelite.aspect: Image shape: 16:9, 9:16 (vertical, ideal for TikTok), 4:3, 1:1 or 21:9.
tip.stagelite.speaker_link: To connect: link the remote to a screen and right-click the speaker. You can disconnect it here.
message.stagelite.speaker_linked: Speaker connected: it now plays the screen's audio.
message.stagelite.speaker_need_screen: First link the remote to a screen (aim at the picture and right-click), then right-click the speaker.
message.stagelite.speaker_no_space: Not enough free space: this speaker needs %s wide and %s tall (to the right and above the block you click).
